info.timeAllocation: Study hour (500h) = 33.75h contact hours (1newslot/week*15week) + 1.5h capstone project defense + 464.75h self-study
info.prerequisite:
o Successfully complete (*) below topics:
- Project Management – PMG201c or PMG202c
o Pass 60% of total credits of selected combo.
o Pass OJT202 (not apply to international students)
o Pass 80% of total credits (PHE_COM* and OJT excluded)

(*): FR must be greater than or equal to 4.
info.description:
The captone project provides students, working in groups, with a significant project experience in which they can integrate much of the material they have learned in their program, including matters relating to requirements, design, implementation, human factors, professionalism, and project management. Students should be expected to deliver one or several iterations of a software system, along with all artifacts appropriate to the process model they are using. These would likely include

a) Project management Plan (perhaps updated regularly),

b) System Requirements Specifications

c) Architectural and Design Documents (Schematic, pcb, protocol, ...)

d) Test Documentation

e) System package & the user guides (package content, installation guide & user manuals)

All the documents in the project implementation process and the progress reports are required to write in English.
info.studentTasks:
- Choose appropriate project and form group (2-3 students/group).

- Divide and schedule work among members.

- Attend all scheduled meeting with supervisor.

- Produce document and product according to project requirement and member work share.

- Defend work infront of examination board, showing both project results and individual responsibility.

In case of cheating found, the whole team is not allow to defend.
info.tools: Appropriate tools for design and implementation.
info.note:
Final Result = OGA*50% + TDA*50%

In which:

1) On-going Assessment (OGA)

- Project Introduction (Report 1): 4%

- Project Management Plan (Report 2): 8%

- System Requirement (Report 3): 16%

- System Design (Report 4): 18%

- Testing (Report 5): 18%

- User Guides (Report 6): 4%

- Implementation (Report 7): 32%

2) Thesis Defense Assessment (TDA)

- Project Introduction: 5%

- Project Management Plan: 5%

- System Requirement: 15%

- System Design: 10%

- Testing: 10%

- User Guides: 5%

- Implementation: 35%

- Presentation Skills: 5%

- Q&A: 10%

Completion Criteria:

1. OGA >= 5

2. TDA >= 4/10

3. Final Result >= 5

Before thesis defense, students must wait until the second thesis defense round if they have the OGA less than 5/10 OR they are in one of below cases:

(1) Students can't prove the fact that they prepare any of the project reports or the output system by themselves

(2) There are more than 3 obvious logic defects OR more than 1 show-stopper defects (the defects that prevent end user from completing his/her use case on any system functions) in the submitted system.

The student(s) has to re-do the capstone project if the above cases occur with the assessments for the second thesis defense OR there is one OGA with grade (see the list above) less than 2/10.

After thesis defense, student(s) is evaluated as failed the capstone project if they are in one of below cases (no matter when the guiding teacher doesn't evaluate that):

(1) Student can't demonstrate any function or use case

(2) Students can't prove the fact that they prepare any of the project reports or the output system by themselves

(3) There are more than 3 obvious logic defects OR more than 1 show-stopper defects (the defects that prevent end user from completing his/her use case on any system functions) in the submitted system.
